# MapFocus Just a simple plugin with 2 functions you can toggle: 1. Stop the map from centering on you. 2. Center the map when it opens. (Also have a button and command to manually center the map) # Installation Add
``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tigurand/DalamudPlugins/refs/heads/main/repo.json ``` to list of custom repo under Experimental tab in Dalamud settings. Install and enable MapFocus.
